d:
2024 men kuchh laitin ameriki rus ke lie torphor karte hue pakre gae. DW ki partal dikhati hai ki vo mosko ki khufiya sevaon se kaise jure aur kisne unhen bharti kiya.
Shuruaat polaind ki kanstrakshan saplaee kanpni men aagazni se huee. phir mamlon men chekiya aur romaniya men giraftariyan hueen. kuchh hafton bad lithuaaniyaee janchkartaon ne sainy upakran jalane ki sazish pakri. sabhi sandigdh spainish-bhashi deshon se the, lekin janch unhen rusi khufiya sevaon tak le gaee.
